subject: hazard side-edge books: p02_clock, p02_top1, p05_adaptive, fx_c20_9y, fr_c20_9y
rule: All five become 'negative control' (they keep running for the record; their call-vs-put lean leaves the panel) if p02_clock's strike rate is below the Conductor's, or p02_clock fails 3 or more of the 7 tests against the unchanged Conductor.
line: strike rate below the Conductor's, or 3 or more of 7 tests failed (docs/28 s2; L5-I2 proof plan)
verdict_rule: Applied once, on p43's finished output. If retired, PKG-15 writes the status rows to data/learning/status.jsonl and PKG-07's panel reads them. p05_adaptive results are flagged as contaminated by the L5-B1 calibrator bias. The owner accepts the outcome (owner decision list).
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order
sessions: the 11 chronological sessions of the p43 overnight replay (data/replay/batch/p43_*); p43 is the first chronological test, p42 used model_v2 in-sample and is not evidence
note: Written while p43 was still running. Nobody in this build read any p43 result before this line was written.

subject: family veto twin conductor_fv
rule: Refuse a fired Conductor trigger when a FREE pool member logged IV_RICH or OI_WALL (c20_9y) or STALE_IMPULSE (c20_9s) in the same second; stay flat and stay free for later triggers.
line: same second, those three frozen veto reasons only; busy members cannot veto (L3-I1)
verdict_rule: No verdict before 20 out-of-sample vetoed triggers. Both framings are reported every night: Conductor-level (all 7 tests, test 6 included, which it fails by construction: 7.2 to 6.1 trades a day) and rule-level R-021 (restricted vs free per pool book, membership permutation). The verdict is the owner's.
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order
sessions: live and replay books from 12 Nov, read from each pool book's saved ctl['veto_log'] (PKG-05); the in-sample 19 Oct-11 Nov reconstruction (115 to 98 trades) is shown greyed and is never quoted as evidence
days_to_verdict: about 3-5 weeks at the observed veto rate

subject: the single Forecast Lab promotion rule (which volatility procedure is live)
rule: Fast-off: the live brain switches to P-plain-cal when it loses on the primary metric on 4 or more of the last 5 forward days. Slow-on or switch: the day-block bootstrap (2,000 draws) 90 % interval of the mean daily log-ratio excludes 0 over at least 10 common forward days, and at least 4 of 7 horizons are better.
line: primary metric: 80 % interval (Winkler) score of dF at 5 min, per day; secondary: mean-corrected QLIKE; mean correction c_h applied before any comparison
counting: one score per contestant per forward day
verdict_rule: Applied every night by PKG-10's runner, which writes one decision row {day, live_procedure, rule: PR-003, why}.
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order
contestants: P-plain-cal: 10-min clock x exp(intercept + 25-bucket time-of-day table), fitted on prior sessions only, online kappa on
sessions: forward days from 12 Nov. The back-filled 11 walk days (28 Oct-11 Nov) are the first record: shown, and counted for the fast-off check only (they can switch a brain off, never on)
min_unit: common forward days for slow-on or switch (5 for fast-off)

subject: business clock k_ts for decay, rent and implied move
rule: The display switches to k_ts at once (no parameters). The option-path simulation adopts k_ts only when its 15-min |bias| is no worse than the calendar clock's on at least 2/3 of unseen sessions and its expiry-day |bias| is at most 1 %.
line: k_ts = calendar time left / trading time left, exactly 1 on expiry day; 2/3 of unseen sessions; expiry |bias| <= 1 %; straddle factor on expiry day expected in 0.5-1.1
counting: one bias value per session per horizon
verdict_rule: Stage B of PKG-08 ships only after this passes. The straddle factor is monitored nightly; an expiry-day factor outside 0.5-1.1 is reported.
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order
sessions: walk-forward repricing scorecard over the 16 collected tapes (owner OK, idle machine), then the nightly straddle monitor on every new session
min_unit: every unseen session of the 16 tapes (the plan sets no smaller floor)

subject: tradeable direction (forward-basis re-based outcome y*)
rule: A tradeable 1-min hit rate of at least 55 % on at least 8 of 11 walk days means an entry-timing twin may be designed; otherwise the direction experts get weight 0 from 2 min up and direction claims are retired permanently.
line: y* = F(t+h) - (F(t) + (b(t) - b_mean)), b = options-forward basis, b_mean its 10-min mean; hit >= 55 % on >= 8 of 11 days (L6-I3)
counting: clear calls per day, one hit rate per day
verdict_rule: Applied once by PKG-11 step 1 (tradeable_dir.py). If it fails, the 1-3 min 'right' column is labelled feed lead-lag for good and L10-I2 is not built.
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order
sessions: the 11 walk days of the walk-forward brains; the tradeable score has not been computed on any of them (only the raw 1-min hit rate, 58-72 %, is known)

subject: oracle gate in front of any volatility, rent, activity or break-even rule
rule: A rule first passes the 7 tests with REALISED values on the 115-trade frozen-pool reconstruction, in both windows and in every dte stratum holding at least 20 % of trades; then its forecast version must pass; then it must be positive on post-freeze days.
line: three stages in order; stratum floor 20 % of trades (L1-I5)
verdict_rule: PKG-12's oracle_ceiling.py writes stage 1 to data/research/predict/oracle_ceiling.json. No forecast-based twin is built for a rule that fails stage 1.
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order
sessions: stage 1 on the 115 reconstructed Conductor trades and the 129 distinct p41 entries; stage 3 on post-freeze days from 12 Nov. Already seen and not evidence for any new rule: L1's oracle AUC 0.54 for realised 15-min volatility on 507 pool trades

subject: admission study rows (at most 5)
rule: Each row is a one-clause yes/no admission rule judged by account_sim against the unchanged Conductor; a blocked trigger frees the account for later triggers.
verdict_rule: A row leaves the list once its forward record fails test 1 or 3 on 20 or more blocked triggers. A row earns a live shadow twin only after the oracle gate (PR-006), leave-one-day-out for its one line, the 7 tests on the reconstruction, and a positive post-freeze record. Leave-one-day-out sets only one-parameter lines.
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order
rows: activity tercile: refuse below q33, with q33 taken from unlabelled training rows
random-skip control at the family-veto rate
sessions: forward Conductor triggers from 12 Nov; the reconstruction is shown greyed

subject: exit-bench rows (one parameter each, fixed now)
rule: Each row is scored on the exit bench with the real strategy classes against the simulated baseline, through account_sim so knock-on counts.
verdict_rule: No verdict before the fidelity gate. A row may become a shadow twin only if it passes all 7 tests in both windows on distinct trades, by dte stratum, without the best trade and best day.
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order
rows: R-rent-dead on k_ts: after 300 s, realised and forecast rent < 0.5 and bid <= entry
hold past TIME while business-clock realised >= implied
sessions: decision-tape days from the first enabled day (PKG-13). L4 already ran some of these on p41; those numbers are seen and are not evidence
min_unit: no verdict before the bench passes its fidelity gate (98 % same-second same-reason exits on tape days; 85 % / 90 % legacy on p41)

subject: re-entry twin rx_c20_9y
rule: Evidence resets to zero on the day the re_leg fix lands. The twin is scored continuously by per-check Spearman per distinct exit window, and retired if that score is 0 or below over 10 sessions.
line: Spearman <= 0 over 10 sessions; label: buy at the ask, 8 % off the peak bid / 15 min / 15:20 (L4-I2)
verdict_rule: Retire on score <= 0 over 10 sessions. Only if the top decile beats 'buy at the first check' and 'never buy' on at least 7 of 10 sessions may the owner consider the buy rule against the 7 tests. Keep or retire now is the owner's choice.
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order
evidence_from_condition: the first session after PKG-05's re_leg fix lands, never earlier than 12 Nov
sessions: live sessions after the fix; the p43 replay gives history only if it ran the fixed code

subject: Forecast Lab earned() gates
rule: earned() is accepted only if its false-earn rate is at most 5 % on 10,000 simulated no-skill days, per horizon and claim.
counting: one earn/no-earn outcome per simulated day per horizon and claim
verdict_rule: If it fails, earned()'s gates are tightened; they are never loosened to pass.
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order

subject: Hedge learning rate
rule: One change only (eta per independent outcome, 0.3-0.5) is accepted if 5-min CRPS is not worse on at least 7 of 11 walk days. The morning shrink is not tested before this verdict.
line: eta in 0.3-0.5 per independent outcome; 7 of 11 walk days
counting: one CRPS per walk day per arm
verdict_rule: Applied once on the paired walk.
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order
sessions: paired walk over the 11 walk days (owner OK, PKG-11)

subject: fill parity for the strict late-observed fill (FILL_LATE_OBSERVED)
rule: The strict late-observed fill is judged by live-vs-replay Conductor trade-list agreement (at least 95 % on healthy days) and by the would-fill counterfactuals, not by rupees.
verdict_rule: The flag stays OFF until the owner flips it.
hypotheses_basis: 65 ideas examined by the 11 Nov round table, plus each pre-registered yes/no hypothesis in order
sessions: live sessions with PKG-05's would_fill observer on, priced by PKG-06's parity.py
min_unit: healthy sessions of would-fill observation (the owner flips after 1-3)
